title: Kth Largest Element in a Stream
description: Design a class to find the `k`th largest element in a stream of numbers. Output the result of each ADD operation.
input_format: First line contains `k` and `m` (number of operations). Following `m` lines contain `ADD x`.
output_format: Outputs of ADD separated by space.
hints: Maintain a min-heap of size at most k.
When the heap exceeds size k, pop the smallest element.
The root of the min-heap `heap[0]` is always the kth largest element.

reference_solution:
import sys, heapq
lines = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
out = []
if lines:
    k, m = int(lines[0].split()[0]), int(lines[0].split()[1])
    heap = []
    for line in lines[1:1+m]:
        parts = line.split()
        if not parts: continue
        v = int(parts[1])
        heapq.heappush(heap, v)
        if len(heap) > k: heapq.heappop(heap)
        out.append(str(heap[0]))
print(' '.join(out))
